# 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/animation-from-interactions.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#animation-from-interactions

## Normative text

[Motion animation](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-motion-animation) triggered by interaction can be disabled, unless the animation is [essential](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-essential) to the functionality or the information being conveyed.

## Sufficient techniques

- C39: Using the CSS prefers-reduced-motion query to prevent motion
- SCR40: Using the CSS prefers-reduced-motion query in JavaScript to prevent motion
- Gx: Allowing users to set a preference that prevents animation
